title: Segmentation fault in C linked list deletion function
description: I am trying to delete a node given a key in a singly linked list in C. My program compiles but segfaults whenever the key is at the head node. Can someone review my pointer traversal?
subject: Programming in C

replies.message: When deleting the head node, you need to update the head pointer itself (`*head_ref = temp->next; free(temp);`). Check if you are passing the pointer by value instead of pointer to pointer (`Node**`).
Thank you Priya! Passing `Node** head` completely fixed the segfault.

title: How to resolve Git merge conflict with upstream main?
description: I forked Campus Buddy and made changes in my branch, but when attempting a git pull upstream main I get conflicts in package.json. What is the safest way to rebase cleanly without losing commits?
subject: Git & Open Source

replies.message: Run `git stash` if you have untracked changes, then `git fetch upstream`, followed by `git rebase upstream/main`. Open VS Code to choose 'Accept Current Change' or 'Incoming Change' in the conflicted file, then `git add package.json` and `git rebase --continue`.
